criteria.text: `GET /week` with no `testimony` param returns a response with no bucket carrying a `testimony` key, for every existing query-parameter combination — checked by asserting `'testimony' in bucket === false` across the fixture, both at the route (`test/server.test.ts`) and at `weekFor` (`test/graph.test.ts`).

`parseWeekQuery({}).method` is `null`; `parseWeekQuery({ testimony: '1' })` resolves `method` to the shared default; `parseWeekQuery({ testimony: '1', method: 'stub' }).method` is `'stub'`; `parseWeekQuery({ testimony: '1', method: 'bad label!' }).method` falls back to the same default as no `method` at all; `parseWeekQuery({ testimony: 'yes', method: 'stub' }).method` is `null` (the literal `1` is required, `yes` does not opt in).

`weekFor(tarcisio, { ...weekBase, days: 30, testimony: true, method: 'stub' })` (or the route equivalent) returns, for the bucket at `daysAgo(7)` (which holds both doc `estadao.com.br/31`, `stub` score 6, and doc `estadao.com.br/36`, `stub` score `null`), `testimony: { score: 6, n: 1 }` — proving the null-scored doc is excluded from both the mean and the count while the bucket still exists.
The same call's bucket at `daysAgo(6)` (doc `estadao.com.br/30`, `stub` score 4, the only scored doc that day) returns `testimony: { score: 4, n: 1 }`.
A bucket with `about: 0` for the same call returns `testimony: null`.
`testimony=1&method=` set to a label with no rows in `doc_testimony` returns `testimony: null` on every bucket, not a 4xx.

`weekTestimonyQuery`'s rendered SQL text (via the `statements` export, alongside `statements.week`) is identical across two sample calls with different `days`/`source`/`method` values — the existing "statements render the same text the routes run" invariant, extended to the new builder.

The docs state, somewhere in `docsText` (`test/docs.ts`), that `/week` accepts a `testimony=1` flag, that it adds a per-bucket `testimony: { score, n } | null` value, that the response is byte-for-byte unchanged without the flag, and that `method` resolves through the same charset check and shared default as `/testimony`. Not covered by `test/docs-drift.test.ts` (that suite only checks the collector registry against `docs/sources.md`); this is a new fact, asserted against `docsText`, never against one page's heading or wording.
